svg.title: From lead to documented recovery
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-end-to-end-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From lead to documented recovery; subtitle: Five gates, not a promise of payment; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Ordinal numeric values indicate sequence, not elapsed time or success probability.; caption: Identify the legal lane before researching relatives or offering a recovery contract.; stages: label: Classify; value: Gate 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Separate probate, custodial unclaimed property and sale surplus.; label: Qualify; value: Gate 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify the record, claimant eligibility, deadlines and likely net value.; label: Prove; value: Gate 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Build a sourced relationship chain and resolve contradictory records.; label: Authorize; value: Gate 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Obtain lawful consent and locally reviewed contractual authority.; label: Resolve; value: Gate 5; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Submit through the authorized channel and reconcile actual distributions.
